description: This file is a Makefile for configuring the kernel version, including conditional inclusion of platform-specific kernel details, managing kernel version identifiers, and handling URI sanitization for kernel repository references.

methods.name: remove_uri_prefix
methods.description: Removes URI prefixes (git://, http://, https://) from a URL string.

methods.name: sanitize_uri
methods.description: Sanitizes a URI by replacing various characters with underscores for safe use.
